structured_proposal.proposal_text:
Athletics Club: Event Proposal
Fusion Charity Drive 2027
1. Proposal
Athletics Club proposes 'Fusion Charity Drive 2027', a Charity Drive planned for 2027-01-04 at the
Seminar Hall. We expect approximately 137 attendees for this Charity Drive, in line with turnout at
our previous Charity Drive events. The requested budget of INR 15,000 is realistic and sufficient for
this Charity Drive. Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant
feedback. This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
2. Objectives, resources and risks
Objectives: Strengthen inter-department collaboration; Showcase student talent to the wider campus.
Resources: Venue booking, sound system and a volunteer team of 20 students. Risks: Low turnout due
to overlapping academic schedules; Weather or power disruption.
